qualification.details: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Master's degree in Plant Biotechnology/ Plant Physiology/ Plant Biochemistry/Life sciences/ Microbiology with 4 years / 5 years of Bachelor's degree (1st Division). Candidates having graduate degree in basic Sciences with 3 years of Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have NET/GATE/ICAR-SRF (PhD entrance) qualification and 2 years of research experience. Desirable: Experience in basic plant physiology, biochemistry and molecular techniques, molecular cloning, genetic transformation of crops, particle gun mediated transformation, plant tissue culture, development and analysis of transgenic plants.

content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Master's degree in Plant Biotechnology/ Plant Physiology/ Plant Biochemistry/Life sciences/ Microbiology with 4 years / 5 years of Bachelor's degree (1st Division). Candidates having graduate degree in basic Sciences with 3 years of Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have NET/GATE/ICAR-SRF (PhD entrance) qualification and 2 years of research experience. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICAR IARI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Senior Research Fellow post is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Senior Research Fellow post in the ICAR IARI recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules, with 40 years for women candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Senior Research Fellow at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Research Fellow position will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master's degree in Plant Biotechnology/ Plant Physiology/ Plant Biochemistry/Life sciences/ Microbiology with a 4 or 5-year Bachelor's degree (1st Division).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application screening, followed by an online interview, and finally document verification for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow vacancies?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official ICAR IARI website before the last date, 28 August 2026. Follow the instructions provided in the "How to Apply" section.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual position?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow position at ICAR IARI is a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q10. When is the online interview scheduled for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The online interview for the Senior Research Fellow position is tentatively scheduled for the first week of September 2026, specifically on 01 September 2026.
